$comment: dsh-agent-guard default rule set. Pure data: no code, no absolute paths, no personal workspace names (DESIGN.md §19.6). Patterns support $DSH_HOME and <workspace> placeholders; a trailing /** means 'this directory and everything below'.

protected.label: DSH 会话存储（目录名 = 路径编码键）
protected.why: 会话目录名就是工作区路径的编码键；成批改名或删除会让注册路径与磁盘布局错位（DESIGN.md R1）

protected.label: DSH 工作区注册表与投影缓存
protected.why: workspace.json 由应用自己持有并重写；外部改写会让注册路径与真实路径分裂

protected.label: DSH profile（插件与配置）
protected.why: profile 决定应用如何启动；改坏它会让应用起不来

protected.label: DSH 凭据文件（只读，绝不写）
protected.why: 凭据文件只检查存在与权限元数据，绝不读取内容，更不写入（DESIGN.md §10.3）

protected.label: agent-guard 自身数据（日志与回滚点）
protected.why: 自身日志与快照是复盘依据，必须防篡改（DESIGN.md §10.2）

protected.label: 工作区内的 DSH 元数据目录
protected.why: 工作区里的 .dsh 同属应用私有状态，不是用户项目内容

boundaries.$comment: Workspace roots themselves are protected for link/rename actions: creating a junction on a workspace root is what split identity in the incident.

$comment-failure: Engine faults must degrade to allowed-with-backup + engine-fault warning, never to an unbacked allow (DESIGN.md §6.6).

snapshots.$comment: Retention only ever deletes this plugin's own snapshots (DESIGN.md §8).

workspaceHealth.$comment: Finding codes are stable identifiers: the panel and tests match on them (DESIGN.md §7.2).
